$comment: Web chatbot sample. Loader scriptData fields become ASPECT_SCRIPT_<scriptKey>_DATA_<datakey> (lowercase). Extension settings are submitted as ASPECT_PROPERTY_WEB_<NAME> (STATICLOADERKEY, OIDCCLIENTID, REDIRECTURL, TOKENPATH, TOKENTIMEOUTMS, REDIRECTTIMEOUTMS, REFRESHINTERVALMS, CONFIGTIMEOUTMS); the BFF delivers them in aspect.properties as bare lowercase keys (staticloaderkey, oidcclientid, ...), which the extension reads. OIDC runs when oidcclientid and redirecturl are both set.
title: Chat Assistance
description: Home chatbot. The host shows the launcher on Home load. Members can open the assistant, chat, and minimize it. Optional OIDC: FI token endpoint plus partner redirecturl exchange.

fields.label: Static loader key
fields.help: Key the extension passes to loadSecureExternalScript. Any value, but it must match the <key> in ASPECT_SCRIPT_<key>_URL / _SRI / _DATA_* (default "chatbot").

fields.label: Static loader URL
fields.help: Hosted HTTPS URL of static-loader.js (ASPECT_SCRIPT_chatbot_URL). OLB web only adds the extension's sourceUrl origin to script-src, so the loader's origin must be in the aspect CSP.

fields.label: Partner UI URL
fields.help: HTTPS chat UI page (scriptData.uiurl). Required unless configurl is used.

fields.label: Runtime config URL
fields.help: Optional HTTPS GET returning { schemaVersion, isActive, uiUrl }. Requires uiorigin.

fields.label: Partner UI origin
fields.help: Required when configurl is set; allowed origin for uiurl (scriptData.uiorigin).

fields.label: OIDC client id
fields.help: Registered OIDC consumer id for the FI /aspect/token endpoint. Legacy property key clientid is also accepted.

fields.label: Partner token exchange URL
fields.help: Partner HTTPS endpoint: POST { code } returns { sessionToken, expiresIn }. Required with oidcclientid to enable OIDC.

fields.label: FI token path
fields.help: Path on the FI OLB origin for the authorization-code request (live vs beta per environment).

fields.label: Loader config fetch timeout (ms)
fields.help: Passed to the static loader in extension init.
